title: Flying Robots Are Coming to US Universities
main_content:
Flying devices, called drones, may be one of the most important technologies of the future.

The number of jobs for people who know how to design, build and control them is increasing.

Several U.S. universities and colleges started offering degrees in unmanned aerial systems, or UAS.

One of these universities is the University of Washington in Seattle. Christopher Lum is an aeronautics research scientist with the university’s Autonomous Flight Systems Laboratory. Lum helps students explore how drones can safely share the skies with regular aircraft.

However, the Federal Aviation Administration, or FAA, is creating new rules to control the use of drones.

A new FAA law requires drone owners to register their drones.

Changing current rules may also present problems for students.
